title: Utsang 2K26
venue: SRiX Auditorium, SR University Campus, Warangal, Telangana
theme: AI-Driven Innovation in Sustainable and Resilient Emerging Technologies
summary: Warangal zonal congress hosted by IEEE Student Branch, SR University, connecting students, researchers, academicians, industry experts, and IEEE leaders.
description: Utsang 2K26 was the IEEE Warangal Zonal Student Congress held on 11 April 2026 at SR University. Hosted by the IEEE Student Branch of SR University in collaboration with IEEE Hyderabad Section SAC, the congress focused on AI-driven innovation in sustainable and resilient emerging technologies.
outcomes: 120 verified participants from the Warangal zone and broader Hyderabad Section
Regional networking between student branches, IEEE leaders, faculty, and students
Theme-focused learning around AI-driven sustainable and resilient emerging technologies
